title: The Death of a Ghost
question: Why did the two brothers keep the secret?

meanings.usage: 常用于被动语态，表示某地被认为有鬼魂出没
表示不愉快的回忆或想法一直出现在脑海中
指受雇在农场从事体力劳动的人
尤指从事户外重体力工作的人，美式拼写为laborer
修饰动词，表示动作发生在夜间
修饰名词，描述与夜间相关的事物
指农场里饲养奶牛的建筑
用于形容人做事认真负责，追求尽善尽美
后可接that从句，指猜想某事可能存在或属实
主语通常为事物，宾语为人，常用结构be astonished to do/that
指为死者举行的安葬仪式
指将此前保密的信息公之于众，后可接名词或that从句
常用被动结构be obliged to do sth，表示因法律、义务等不得不做某事
指军人未经允许离开所属部队，是违法行为
指军队的一级编制单位
表示此含义时常用复数形式the authorities
指选择独自生活、避免与他人接触的人

phrases.usage: 表示辞职、放弃工作，可用于主动离职的场景

examples.en: He gave up his job in the city to move back to his hometown.
examples.zh: 他辞去了城里的工作，搬回了家乡。

phrases.usage: 表示熬夜，一整晚不睡觉，强调夜间保持清醒的状态

examples.en: I had to stay up all night to finish the report before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我不得不熬一整晚，在截止日期前完成报告。

phrases.usage: 声称曾经做过某事，to have done是不定式的完成式，表示动作发生在claim之前

examples.en: The man claimed to have seen a UFO flying over the park last week.
examples.zh: 这名男子声称上周看到一个不明飞行物飞过公园上空。

phrases.usage: 表示“最终，经过一段时间之后”，强调经过一段时间后某情况发生

examples.en: In time, everyone forgot about the argument and became friends again.
examples.zh: 最终，所有人都忘记了那次争吵，又成了朋友。

phrases.usage: 表示“不是别人，正是……”，用于强调某人的身份出人意料

examples.en: The winner of the competition was none other than my little sister.
examples.zh: 比赛的获胜者不是别人，正是我的小妹妹。

phrases.phrase: be supposed to have done sth
phrases.usage: 表示“被认为已经做了某事”，暗含该认知可能与事实不符的含义

examples.en: The ancient temple was supposed to have been destroyed in the war, but it still exists.
examples.zh: 人们本以为这座古庙已经在战争中被毁了，但它依然存在。

phrases.usage: 表示“在战斗中，在行动中”，此处指军事作战场景

examples.en: Many soldiers were reported missing in action after the battle.
examples.zh: 战斗结束后，许多士兵被报失踪。

phrases.usage: 表示“躲藏着，隐藏着”，是固定搭配，描述躲避他人的状态

examples.en: The witness remained in hiding until the criminal was arrested.
examples.zh: 在罪犯被逮捕之前，证人一直躲着不露面。

phrases.usage: 表示“不知道，没意识到”，可作状语或表语，后接名词或名词性从句

examples.en: He walked straight past his teacher, completely unaware of her presence.
examples.zh: 他径直从老师身边走过，完全没意识到她在那里。

sentences.en: For years, villagers believed that Endley farm was haunted.
sentences.zh: 多年来，村民们一直认为恩德利农场闹鬼。

sentences.en: The farm was owned by two brothers, Joe and Bob Cox.
sentences.zh: 这个农场归乔和鲍勃·科克斯两兄弟所有。

sentences.en: They employed a few farmhands, but no one was willing to work there long.
sentences.zh: 他们雇了一些农场工人，但没有人愿意在那里长时间工作。

sentences.en: Every time a worker gave up his job, he told the same story.
sentences.zh: 每次有工人辞职，他们都会讲同样的故事。

sentences.en: Farm labourers said that they always woke up to find that work had been done overnight.
sentences.zh: 农场工人说，他们醒来时总是发现工作已经在一夜之间完成了。

sentences.en: Hay had been cut and cowsheds had been cleaned.
sentences.zh: 干草被割了，牛棚也被清理了。

sentences.en: A farm worker, who stayed up all night, claimed to have seen a figure cutting corn in the moonlight.
sentences.zh: 一位彻夜未眠的农场工人声称在月光下看到一个身影在割玉米。

sentences.en: In time, it became an accepted fact that the Cox brothers employed a conscientious ghost that did most of their work for them.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，科克斯兄弟雇佣了一个尽职尽责的幽灵为他们做了大部分工作，这成了一个公认的事实。

sentences.en: No one suspected that there might be someone else on the farm who had never been seen.
sentences.zh: 没有人怀疑农场上可能还有其他人从未被见过。

sentences.en: This was indeed the case.
sentences.zh: 事实确实如此。

sentences.en: A short time ago, villagers were astonished to learn that the ghost of Endley had died.
sentences.zh: 不久前，村民们惊讶地得知恩德利的幽灵已经死了。

sentences.en: Everyone went to the funeral, for the 'ghost' was none other than Eric Cox,
sentences.zh: 所有人都去参加了葬礼，因为那个“幽灵”不是别人，正是埃里克·科克斯，

sentences.en: a third brother who was supposed to have died as a young man.
sentences.zh: 据说他年轻时就去世了的第三个兄弟。

sentences.en: After the funeral, Joe and Bob revealed a secret which they had kept for over fifty years.
sentences.zh: 葬礼结束后，乔和鲍勃揭露了一个他们保守了五十多年的秘密。

sentences.en: Eric had been the eldest son of the family, very much older than his two brothers.
sentences.zh: 埃里克是家里的长子，比他的两个兄弟大得多。

sentences.en: He had been obliged to join the army during the Second World War.
sentences.zh: 第二次世界大战期间，他被迫参军。

sentences.en: As he hated army life, he decided to desert his regiment.
sentences.zh: 由于他厌恶军队生活，他决定开小差。

sentences.en: When he learnt that he would be sent abroad,
sentences.zh: 当他得知自己将被派往国外时，

sentences.en: he returned to the farm and his father hid him until the end of the war.
sentences.zh: 他回到了农场，他的父亲把他藏起来直到战争结束。

sentences.en: Fearing the authorities, Eric remained in hiding after the war as well.
sentences.zh: 由于害怕当局，埃里克在战后也一直躲藏着。

sentences.en: His father told everybody that Eric had been killed in action.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲告诉所有人埃里克在战斗中牺牲了。

sentences.en: The only other people who knew the secret were Joe and Bob.
sentences.zh: 唯一知道这个秘密的其他人是乔和鲍勃。

sentences.en: They did not even tell their wives.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至没有告诉他们的妻子。

sentences.en: When their father died they thought it their duty to keep Eric in hiding.
sentences.zh: 当他们的父亲去世后，他们认为有责任继续把埃里克藏起来。

sentences.en: All these years, Eric had lived as a recluse.
sentences.zh: 这么多年来，埃里克一直过着隐居生活。

sentences.en: He used to sleep during the day and work at night,
sentences.zh: 他白天睡觉，晚上工作，

sentences.en: quite unaware of the fact that he had become the ghost of Endley.
sentences.zh: 完全没有意识到自己已经成为了恩德利的幽灵。

sentences.en: When he died, however, his brothers found it impossible to keep the secret any longer.
sentences.zh: 然而，当他去世后，他的兄弟们发现再也无法保守这个秘密了。

exercises.prompt: “当局，官方” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: authority · /ɔːˈθɒrəti/ · noun · 当局，官方。表示此含义时常用复数形式the authorities

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：认真的，尽责的，勤恳的
exercises.explain: conscientious · /ˌkɒnʃiˈenʃəs/ · adjective · 认真的，尽责的，勤恳的。用于形容人做事认真负责，追求尽善尽美

exercises.hint: 最终，所有人都忘记了那次争吵，又成了朋友。

exercises.explain: They employed a few farmhands, but no one was willing to work there long. — 他们雇了一些农场工人，但没有人愿意在那里长时间工作。

exercises.prompt: “当句子的真正主语或宾语是不定式、动名词或从句时，为了避免句子头重脚轻，用it作形式上的主语或宾语，真正的主语/宾语放在句尾” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 作形式主语：It + 谓语 + 名词/形容词 + 真正主语（不定式/that从句）；作形式宾语：主语 + 动词 + it + 宾补 + 真正宾语（不定式/that从句）
options: 间接宾语和直接宾语 (Indirect and Direct Objects)
as if 引导的方式状语从句
exercises.explain: it作形式主语/形式宾语：作形式主语：It + 谓语 + 名词/形容词 + 真正主语（不定式/that从句）；作形式宾语：主语 + 动词 + it + 宾补 + 真正宾语（不定式/that从句）：可让句子结构更平衡，符合英语表达习惯

我们很幸运，只有较低的田地，
exercises.explain: They did not even tell their wives. — 他们甚至没有告诉他们的妻子。

grammar.title: 过去完成时
grammar.definition: 表示过去某个时间或动作之前已经发生或完成的动作，即“过去的过去”
grammar.usage: 常用于描述在过去某个已知事件之前发生的背景事件，常和after, before, until等引导的时间状语连用

examples.en: Eric had been the eldest son of the family, very much older than his two brothers.
examples.zh: 埃里克是家里的长子，比他的两个弟弟大很多。

examples.en: He had been obliged to join the army during the Second World War.
examples.zh: 第二次世界大战期间，他被迫参军。

grammar.title: it作形式主语/形式宾语
grammar.definition: 当句子的真正主语或宾语是不定式、动名词或从句时，为了避免句子头重脚轻，用it作形式上的主语或宾语，真正的主语/宾语放在句尾
grammar.structure: 作形式主语：It + 谓语 + 名词/形容词 + 真正主语（不定式/that从句）；作形式宾语：主语 + 动词 + it + 宾补 + 真正宾语（不定式/that从句）
grammar.usage: 可让句子结构更平衡，符合英语表达习惯

examples.en: It became an accepted fact that the Cox brothers employed a conscientious ghost.
examples.zh: 考克斯兄弟雇了一个勤恳的鬼魂，这成了人们公认的事实。

examples.en: His brothers found it impossible to keep the secret any longer.
examples.zh: 他的弟弟们发现再也没法保守这个秘密了。

grammar.title: used to do 结构
grammar.definition: 表示过去经常性、习惯性的动作或存在的状态，且该动作或状态现在已经不再发生或存在
grammar.structure: 主语 + used to + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 用于今昔对比，强调过去的情况与现在不同

examples.en: He used to sleep during the day and work at night.
examples.zh: 他过去常常白天睡觉，晚上干活。

examples.en: I used to swim in this lake when I was a child.
examples.zh: 我小时候经常在这个湖里游泳。

patterns.pattern: Every time + 从句, 主句

original.en: Every time a worker gave up his job, he told the same story.
original.zh: 每次有工人辞工，都会讲同样的事。

examples.en: Every time it rains, the old street becomes very muddy.
examples.zh: 每次下雨，这条老街道就会变得非常泥泞。

examples.en: Every time I visit my grandmother, she prepares a lot of delicious food for me.
examples.zh: 每次我去看望奶奶，她都会给我准备很多好吃的。

patterns.pattern: No one suspected that + 从句

original.en: No one suspected that there might be someone else on the farm who had never been seen.
original.zh: 没有人想到农场里可能还有一个从未露过面的人。

examples.en: No one suspected that the quiet young man was actually a famous painter.
examples.zh: 没有人想到那个安静的年轻人其实是一位著名画家。

examples.en: No one suspected that the small village hid such a beautiful secret garden.
examples.zh: 没有人想到这个小村庄里藏着这么漂亮的秘密花园。

patterns.pattern: When + 时间状语从句, 主语 + think/find + it + 名词/形容词 + to do sth

original.en: When their father died they thought it their duty to keep Eric in hiding.
original.zh: 父亲去世后，他们认为有责任继续把埃里克藏起来。

examples.en: When he moved to this city, he found it difficult to adapt to the fast-paced life.
examples.zh: 搬到这个城市后，他发现很难适应这里快节奏的生活。

examples.en: When we participate in group activities, we all think it important to respect others' opinions.
examples.zh: 我们参加集体活动时，都认为尊重他人的意见很重要。
